story: Apple headset leak reveals new details and confirms earlier rumors
text: We might just not know what we are missing. I used to think that video calls is a solved problem until I saw Google's Project Starline [0]. Video calls in AR could be vastly better, not just a little bit, but basically a completely different experience/relationship. [0] [VIDEO]

story: Who is still inside the metaverse?
text: I think the most promising Metaverse technology might be something like Starline [1]. No headset to wear. No disorientation. You just sit down and you're there with somebody else. [1] [VIDEO]

story: We need technology that is less immersive, not more
text: This is true of games, but not other applications. You need photorealism to have immersive video calls -- as if you are meeting in person. Here is a tech demo by Google; see how users respond to the realism: [VIDEO] So we do need more immersive technology; just maybe not for games.

story: Project Starline: Feel like you're there, together
text: If you watch the video of it: [VIDEO] Interesting thing to note is that they don't show the participants touching the glass pane 'separating' them, whereas for that kind of situation it would be very very natural thing to do. I guess doing so (reaching towards the 'glass pane') would make the imagery distort/degrade real fast as you would start going out of camera's FoV, which that would break the magic.
